plan: Since values are drawn randomly between $0-$49, rational bidders will likely bid strategically around their true value. My value is $22. I want to bid just enough to win without overpaying. A good strategy is to bid slightly above my value, anticipating other bidders might also bid near their true values. I'll bid around $25-$26 to increase my chances of winning while minimizing overpayment risk.

In a second-price sealed bid auction with values between $0-$49, the optimal strategy is typically to bid close to my true value. Since my value is $34, I'll bid strategically just above what I expect others might bid. Given the random distribution, other rational bidders might bid around their own values. I'll bid slightly above the midpoint of the range to increase my winning probability while protecting my potential profit margin.

With a private value of $10, I want to bid strategically. Since values are uniformly drawn between $0-$49, the expected value for other bidders is $24.50. Rational bidders will likely bid close to their private value. My optimal strategy is to bid slightly above my value to increase my winning chances, but not so high that I risk negative earnings. I'll bid around $15 - high enough to potentially win, but not overcommitting.
